dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Three prominent 'O' shaped structures on the mid-dorsal surface display irregular, crenulated light-intensity perimeters with widths varying between 4-12 pixels. These structures transition sharply from a dark-value exterior to a high-value perimeter before returning to a dark-value interior core, typical of ringed patterns.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: High spatial density of small, solid light-intensity pixel clusters is concentrated on the lower lateral flank and towards the posterior. These clusters appear as individual points ranging from 2-6 pixels in diameter, lacking internal gradients and forming asymmetrical stippled groupings.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of the three most prominent mid-dorsal macro-annuli form an obtuse scalene triangle. Posterior to this, a group of four high-intensity blobs on the lower lateral surface forms an irregular quadrilateral geometric relationship following the curvature of the flank.
